id: title:Gilbert09:add open exchange rates time series and ohlc tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for Open Exchange Rates OHLC and time-series exchange rate endpoints, while removing the legacy analytical rate summary. This could support warehouse ingestion of OHLC and time-series exchange rate data.
review.reason: The change removes the Open Exchange Rates analytical rate summary and its ingestion, while adding implementation and metadata for OHLC and time-series endpoints. Tests are added to verify the new behavior. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual adoption and benefit depend on warehouse configuration and plan tier, not demonstrated by the code alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No untrusted instructions. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Removes the Open Exchange Rates source from the warehouse coverage appendix and its corresponding Python and settings files.
observations.code_quote: - [x] `ohlc.json` — open/high/low/close/average per period - the vendor's analytical rate summary (medium)
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the Open Exchange Rates ingestion path, including its Python implementation and settings, from the warehouse sources. This could reduce warehouse ingestion, potentially removing historical exchange rate data from warehouse tables.

observations.behavior: Adds the OHLC and time-series endpoints to the Open Exchange Rates canonical descriptions, including their columns and documentation.

observations.behavior: Adds the OHLC and time-series endpoints to the warehouse ingestion implementation, including their respective iteration and fetching functions.
